# Mauk Tenieb · Korhogo Fauna

> Mauk Tenieb · Korhogo Fauna — Transmedia Underground Worldbuilder. Lure, Lore, More.

> Transmedia Underground Worldbuilder. Lure, Lore, More. The Korhogo Fauna — a Science Fiction world [Jorge Luis Borges, William Seward Burroughs, Evald Ilyenkov...] and an uncanny crucible-platform for: Experimental Hip-Hop, Concept Albums, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub — also: RPG, Games, Videos, Pictures, Collaborations, Literature (massive diary).

> Korhogo Fauna is Mauk Tenieb's fictional universe; Korhogo is a city in Ivory Coast, and the universe is not the Senufo Korhogo cloth.
